"""
Repro for: Django Admin with Inlines not using UUIDField default value
(ticket #32210). Mirrors the admin add flow: a ModelForm for the parent and
an inline formset built on form.instance, both fed the same POST data.
Uses tests/model_formsets models, which match the reported shape:
ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey (auto pk + UUIDField unique default, editable=False)
ChildRelatedViaAK (FK to_field='uuid').
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={
        "default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}
    },
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "tests.model_formsets",
    ],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django import forms
from django.db import connection

from tests.model_formsets.models import (
    ChildRelatedViaAK,
    ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey,
)

with connection.schema_editor() as schema_editor:
    schema_editor.create_model(ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey)
    schema_editor.create_model(ChildRelatedViaAK)

ParentForm = forms.modelform_factory(
    ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey, fields=["name"]
)
ChildFormSet = inlineformset_factory = None  # placeholder to fail fast if import below breaks

from django.forms.models import inlineformset_factory  # noqa: E402

ChildFormSet = inlineformset_factory(
    ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey, ChildRelatedViaAK, fields="__all__"
)

data = {
    "name": "Test Parent",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-TOTAL_FORMS": "3",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-INITIAL_FORMS": "0",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-MAX_NUM_FORMS": "",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-0-name": "Test Child",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-1-name": "",
    "childrelatedviaak_set-2-name": "",
}

# Admin flow (_changeform_view): formsets are constructed with form.instance
form = ParentForm(data)
formset = ChildFormSet(data, instance=form.instance)

assert form.is_valid(), form.errors
assert formset.is_valid(), formset.errors

uuid_after_validation = formset.instance.uuid
print("parent instance uuid after formset validation:", uuid_after_validation)
assert uuid_after_validation is not None, (
    "BUG: inline formset nulled the parent's UUIDField default "
    "(to_field) even though form data was provided"
)

form.save()
formset.save()

parent = ParentWithUUIDAlternateKey.objects.get()
child = ChildRelatedViaAK.objects.get()
print("saved parent uuid:", parent.uuid)
print("saved child parent_id:", child.parent_id)
assert child.parent_id == parent.uuid
print("OK: admin-style add with inline preserved the UUID default")
